entries.name: DuckDuckGo search
entries.description: Type ddg and some words to search DuckDuckGo; ddg alone opens its home page. Runs no code.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Tidy up whitespace
entries.description: Universal Actions: select text in any app, collapse its spaces and line breaks, and paste it back. Runs no code.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Case converter (Node, Alfred format)
entries.description: Type case and some words to get camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more. A script plugin that needs Node.js.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Color tools
entries.description: Convert HEX, RGB and HSL colors or check text contrast. Try color #f5b52c or color #fff on #111. Requires Node.js 22+.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Pomodoro
entries.description: Focus and break timers with pause, resume and saved progress. Type pomo start 25. Check time with pomo status; no background alarms. Requires Node.js 22+.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Translate in browser
entries.description: Type tr fr hello to open Google Translate with automatic source detection. Text is sent only when you open the result. Requires Node.js 22+.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Tauri docs
entries.description: Search a curated local index of Tauri 2 guides. Type tauri updater; Enter opens the official page. Requires Node.js 22+.
entries.author: Sevak
